selection: Minimum equal-race 90% interval score using leave-one-development-race-out residual priors; point estimator remains v0.5
target: Same retrospective eligible within-stint targets; dry-compound only, including any qualifying subset of wet events
prior: Equal race weighted standardized absolute residual distribution, discretized at 201 midpoint quantiles
adaptation: Only earlier scored errors from same driver in current race, retained across stints; no cross-driver pooling
limitations: Empirical adaptive predictive intervals; no exchangeability/coverage guarantee; not epistemic tyre uncertainty
